mechanism: Nalmefene is an opioid antagonist that may precipitate withdrawal symptoms in opioid-dependent patients and can potentiate CNS effects; lithium has a narrow therapeutic window and both drugs affect renal function and electrolyte balance.
action: Monitor lithium levels closely if nalmefene is initiated or discontinued; assess for signs of lithium toxicity and ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative opioid antagonist if possible.
